name: Minamoto no Yoshinaka
source:
Son of Minamoto no Yoshitaka.
After his father was killed, he was brought up in Kiso, Shinshu, where he was also known as Kiso no Kaja.
He often behaved in a crude manner and was not very good at fighting with intelligence and strategy, but he was so skilled that he could outstrip them.
His imposing appearance attracts people around him and raises their morale.
